countryHub-Indonisia.name: Indonesia
countryHub-Indonisia.intro: Between volcanoes, islands, temples, and everyday street life, explore a cultural world woven from a thousand islands.This is far more than a mere travel destination; it is a collection of cultural vignettes capturing nature, faith, migration and modern life.

overview-Indonisia.title: Country Impression
overview-Indonisia.subtitle: Read a cultural world of a thousand islands, between volcanoes, temples, and everyday life.

indonesia.name: Indonesia
indonesia.locationDetail: Located between Southeast Asia and Oceania, consisting of over 17,000 islands straddling the equator.
indonesia.intro: Indonesia is not a single landmass, but an archipelago connected by the sea. From port cities to volcanic villages, from mosques to Hindu temples, its culture is continually shaped by migration, trade, colonial history, and urbanization.

description.line1: We run freely under the sun, feeling the wind, warmth, and openness;
description.line2: we also gather in corner cafés, exchanging stories and perspectives with people from around the world.
description.line3: Here, every meeting is more than a brief escape or moment of relaxation;
description.line4: it is a warm and honest conversation that breaks boundaries.

monsoon-desert.name: People in the Monsoon and Desert
monsoon-desert.description: Listen to their stories and discover the real Indonesia and Yemen beyond travel images.

campus-cultural-exchange.location: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
campus-cultural-exchange.description: An introduction to the history and culture of Morocco and Germany for students from different countries.

indoor-english-corner.name: Indoor English Corner
indoor-english-corner.location: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
indoor-english-corner.description: An indoor English corner where participants shared their favorite films.
highlights: A Russian student shared an animated film

outdoor-group-games.name: Outdoor Group Games
outdoor-group-games.description: Light outdoor activities under the sun, designed for full relaxation of body and mind.

monsoon-desert.content: This sharing session is about monsoons, deserts, and people. Young speakers from different cultural backgrounds will share stories about growth, migration, food, and everyday life.
The event hopes to reveal a world beyond travel photos: a world of ordinary people, difficulties, humor, intimacy, and everyday wisdom.

campus-cultural-exchange.content: This campus cultural exchange focused on Morocco and Germany. Through historical introductions, language activities, hands-on experiences, and music sharing, participants rediscovered two countries that are often simplified by stereotypes.

campus-cultural-exchange.caption: A cultural introduction session during the event

campus-cultural-exchange.content: We explored cultural differences in a relaxed way and helped students from different countries build real connections through games and conversations.

indoor-english-corner.content: This English corner centered on films. Participants shared their favorite movies, animations, and characters while practicing English in a relaxed atmosphere.

indoor-english-corner.caption: Sharing moments at the indoor English corner

outdoor-group-games.content: At Zhongshan Sports Park, we organized a relaxed outdoor group activity. The event was not about winning or losing, but about slowing down in the sun, on the grass, and through laughter.
After the games, participants sat together, talked, played guitar, sang songs, and shared their experiences of living in the city.

zhang-ming.name: Zhang Ming
zhang-ming.text: This event completely changed how I understand cultural exchange. Through conversations and games, I realized that culture is not distant knowledge, but real people and real stories.

li-yutong.name: Li Yutong
li-yutong.text: The event helped me make friends from around the world. We talked, shared food, discussed films, and understood each other’s differences in a relaxed atmosphere.

morocco.name: Morocco
morocco.description: From the Sahara Desert to the blue town of Chefchaouen, Morocco is a kaleidoscope of color and culture.

travelGuide.label: Travel Guide
travelGuide.desc: Practical guides for countries and cities

thoughts.title: Thought Encounters
thoughts.subtitle: Travel is not only about taking photos, arriving, and checking in; it is also a way to understand ourselves through unfamiliar cultures.

featured.title: Beside a Morning Ritual in Bali
featured.text: I thought I was only an observer. But when I raised my camera, I realized that the distance between me and the local people had changed. In that moment, travel was no longer just about watching; it became a lesson about boundaries, respect, and understanding.

cultural-boundary.title: When tourists watch a ritual, is it respect or disturbance?
cultural-boundary.text: When a religious ritual enters a tourist's camera frame, is it still part of local life, or has it become a consumed spectacle?

travel-gaze.title: Why do we keep searching for something “authentic”?
travel-gaze.text: So-called authentic culture may not be a frozen tradition, but a relationship that constantly changes within modern life.

urban-life.title: Does tourism make a city more open, or more expensive?
urban-life.text: The travel economy brings income, but it may also reshape rents, consumption patterns, and the rhythm of local communities.

media-impact.title: How do short videos reshape destinations?
media-impact.text: A place may become popular because of a single video, but it may also lose its everyday order because of overexposure.

citiesPage.title: Enter the Cities
citiesPage.subtitle: Every city is a way of life. Together, they form Indonesia’s complex and fascinating cultural landscape.

bali.name: Bali
bali.description: A space where islands, temples, rituals, and resort culture intertwine.

jakarta.name: Jakarta
jakarta.description: A meeting point of modern urban life, commercial spaces, and diverse communities.

yogyakarta.name: Yogyakarta
yogyakarta.description: An important city of Javanese culture, traditional arts, and heritage memory.

travelGuide.heroSubtitle: Save cultural insights, route planning, and practical information in one place. This page currently works as a static travel guide and can later expand into a filterable, saveable, and downloadable trip planning tool.

nationalGuide.title: Country Guide
nationalGuide.description: This section works as a pre-departure overview checklist, helping travelers quickly understand the most basic and easily overlooked preparations for traveling in Indonesia.

entryPreparation.title: Entry and Departure Preparation
entryPreparation.text: Prepare your passport, visa, flight tickets, accommodation confirmations, insurance, and backup copies of important documents before departure.

bestSeason.title: Best Travel Season
bestSeason.text: Indonesia has a tropical climate overall. Before traveling, adjust your route according to the rainy season, dry season, and your destination cities.

transportation.title: Inter-island and City Transport
transportation.text: As a country made up of many islands, common transport options include flights, ferries, private cars, motorbikes, ride-hailing services, and urban public transport.

budget.title: Budget and Spending
budget.text: Both backpacking and resort-style trips can be planned. Your budget should consider accommodation, inter-island transport, food, tickets, and local experiences.

safetyHealth.title: Safety and Health
safetyHealth.text: Pay attention to food hygiene, traffic safety, risks from sea activities, mosquito protection, and personal belongings. It is also helpful to learn about local medical resources in advance.

etiquette.title: Cultural Etiquette
etiquette.text: When entering religious sites, pay attention to clothing and photography etiquette. Respect local rituals, private space, and religious customs in different regions.

bali.text: Ideal for island vacations, temple visits, traditional dance, rice terrace walks, and short cultural experiences.

jakarta.text: Ideal for observing modern Indonesian city life, commercial spaces, historic districts, and diverse population flows.

yogyakarta.text: Ideal for exploring Borobudur, Prambanan, traditional arts, crafts, and Javanese culture.

islandRelax.title: Relaxed Island Route
islandRelax.text: Center your trip around Bali, with beaches, temples, rice terraces, cafés, and one or two short nature experiences.

cultureObservation.title: Cultural Observation Route
cultureObservation.text: Combine Jakarta and Yogyakarta to understand Indonesia's layered culture through urban life, museums, heritage sites, and traditional arts.

islandHopping.title: Inter-island Exploration Route
islandHopping.text: Suitable for travelers with more time, allowing richer movement between Bali, Java, and surrounding islands.

items.templeClothes: Long pants or a shawl for temple visits

toolkit.title: Expandable Travel Tools
toolkit.description: This page can first work as a static guide. In the next stage, it can add filters, saving features, city detail pages, PDF downloads, route generators, and even automatic itinerary combinations based on trip length.

cityDetail.subtitle: Between streets, food, rituals, and landmarks, observe how local life meets travelers’ imagination.

bali.localLanguage: Indonesian, along with Balinese and other local languages.
bali.keywords: Island, temples, rituals, rice terraces, resorts, traditional arts.
bali.description: {{city}} is not only a travel destination, but also a real living space for local people. Through food, culture, and places, we see not only scenery, but also the long relationship between people and place.

jakarta.name: Jakarta
jakarta.localLanguage: Indonesian, along with Javanese, Sundanese, and other local languages.
jakarta.keywords: Capital city, business, neighborhoods, museums, modern life, diverse communities.
jakarta.description: {{city}} is an important entry point for understanding modern Indonesia. Skyscrapers, shopping malls, old districts, markets, and community life come together, revealing the complexity of a country in urban transformation.

yogyakarta.name: Yogyakarta
yogyakarta.localLanguage: Indonesian, along with Javanese and other local languages.
yogyakarta.keywords: Heritage, art, Javanese culture, crafts, slow travel, university town.
yogyakarta.description: {{city}} carries a strong Javanese cultural atmosphere. Heritage sites, crafts, street art, and everyday life are interwoven here, making it a place to slowly observe how culture continues today.

food.title: Understanding a City Through a Local Meal
food.text: Spices, rice, street stalls, and family flavors together shape the taste memories of travel.

culture.title: Ritual Is Not Performance, but Everyday Life
culture.text: In temples, neighborhoods, and family spaces, we observe how culture enters daily life.

places.title: The City Stories Behind the Scenery
places.text: Landmarks are more than check-in spots; they are entrances to history, belief, and local memory.
